explication: skillshare is a cross-platform manager for AI-agent skills and related resources. The main workflow is to maintain shared source content and configuration, then sync skills, agents, extras, MCP connections, and plugins to agent targets; users can also install content from Git hosts and audit it before use. A web dashboard exposes these operations alongside project, hub, backup, and management features. The README documents product capabilities; sampled source confirms selected UI/API, search, preview, hub indexing, MCP, and plugin behavior, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
